device.title: Select Devices
device.description: Choose which devices to monitor in Home Assistant. At least one device must be selected.

reconfigure.title: Select Devices
reconfigure.description: Update which devices are monitored in Home Assistant.

error.no_devices_selected: At least one device must be selected.

abort.local_host_configured: Local network access for the discovered Phyn Plus was configured automatically.
abort.not_phyn_local: The discovered device does not answer as a Phyn device on the local network.

init.title: Phyn Options
init.description: Choose which alert types should be suppressed, how often the Phyn cloud is polled, and optionally a local network IP address per Phyn Plus for direct LAN access (faster updates, valve control that works during internet outages). Leave an IP field empty to disable local access for that device.

error.local_host_unreachable: No Phyn device answered at this address. Check the IP and that the device is on the same network.
error.local_host_mismatch: A device answered, but it is not this Phyn device. Check which IP belongs to which device.

not_loaded.message: The Phyn integration is not loaded.

no_target.message: No target was provided. Target a Phyn device, entity, or area.

no_phyn_plus_target.message: The target does not include a Phyn Plus device. This action requires a device with a shutoff valve.

leak_test_failed.message: The Phyn API rejected the leak test request for {device}.

leak_test.name: Start a leak test
leak_test.description: Starts an on-demand leak (health) test on the targeted Phyn Plus device(s).

extended.name: Extended test
extended.description: Run the longer, more sensitive version of the leak test.

pause_autoshutoff.name: Pause auto shutoff
pause_autoshutoff.description: Temporarily disables automatic water shutoff on the targeted Phyn Plus device(s), for example while running sprinklers or filling a pool.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long automatic shutoff should stay paused. It re-enables automatically afterwards.

mark_alert_read.name: Mark alert as read
mark_alert_read.description: Marks a Phyn alert as read in the Phyn app, e.g. after an automation has handled it. The alert ID is provided by the Alert event entity.

alert_id.name: Alert ID
alert_id.description: The ID of the alert to mark as read.
